title: Part 5 Practice: Languages and Settlement Types in Ethiopia

questions.text: The diagram below shows language families in Ethiopia. Which language family does Oromo belong to?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <text x="80" y="20" fill="#facc15" font-size="8">Language Families of Ethiopia</text>
                    <rect x="15" y="30" width="85" height="90" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="30" y="48" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Cushitic</text>
                    <text x="25" y="63" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Oromo</text>
                    <text x="25" y="76" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Somali</text>
                    <text x="25" y="89" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Afar</text>
                    <text x="25" y="102" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Sidama</text>
                    <rect x="110" y="30" width="85" height="90" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="125" y="48" fill="#14b8a6" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Semitic</text>
                    <text x="120" y="63" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Amharic</text>
                    <text x="120" y="76" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Tigrinya</text>
                    <text x="120" y="89" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Gurage</text>
                    <rect x="205" y="30" width="85" height="90" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="220" y="48" fill="#f59e0b" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Omotic</text>
                    <text x="215" y="63" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Wolaytta</text>
                    <text x="215" y="76" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Gamo</text>
                    <text x="215" y="89" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Kafa</text>
                </svg>

questions.explanation: Correct: Oromo belongs to the Cushitic branch of Afro-Asiatic. A is wrong—Amharic and Tigrinya are Semitic. C is wrong—Wolaytta and Kafa are Omotic. D is wrong—Nuer and Anuak are Nilo-Saharan.

questions.text: The diagram below shows settlement patterns. What is the most common settlement pattern in the Ethiopian highlands?

questions.text: The diagram shows settlement types. What is the difference between temporary and permanent settlements?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <text x="80" y="20" fill="#facc15" font-size="8">Settlement Comparison</text>
                    <rect x="15" y="30" width="125" height="90" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="40" y="48" fill="#f59e0b" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Temporary</text>
                    <text x="25" y="63" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Mobile/Movable</text>
                    <text x="25" y="76" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Seasonal</text>
                    <text x="25" y="89" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Low impact</text>
                    <text x="25" y="102" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Pastoral</text>
                    <rect x="160" y="30" width="125" height="90" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f43f5e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="185" y="48" fill="#f43f5e" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Permanent</text>
                    <text x="170" y="63" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Year-round</text>
                    <text x="170" y="76" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Fixed structures</text>
                    <text x="170" y="89" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Infrastructure</text>
                    <text x="170" y="102" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Services</text>
                    <text x="30" y="135" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">Temporary: Mobile, Seasonal</text>
                    <text x="30" y="148" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">Permanent: Year-round, Fixed</text>
                </svg>

options: A) Temporary settlements are larger than permanent
B) Temporary settlements are mobile and seasonal while permanent are year-round with fixed structures
D) Permanent settlements are only found in cities
questions.correct_answer: B) Temporary settlements are mobile and seasonal while permanent are year-round with fixed structures
questions.explanation: Correct: This is the key difference. A is wrong—temporary are usually smaller. C is wrong—there are clear differences. D is wrong—permanent settlements are also in rural areas.
